extra.note: ARK token issuer. Domain field on-ledger = ark.institute. TOML lists address under [[ISSUERS]]. Charitable funding platform.
Soil operational wallet. Domain field on-ledger = xrpl.soil.co. TOML lists address under [[ACCOUNTS]]. ORQO Group, Abu Dhabi.

extra.brand_warn: Vanity address starts with 'rBitcoiN' and currency code is 'BITx' — visually adjacent to BTC. Label exists so users can distinguish this self-attested project token from canonical BTC issuers.
extra.note: BITx token. Domain field on-ledger = bitx.fyi. TOML lists address under [[ISSUERS]] and currency under [[TOKENS]]. Master key disabled, regkey blackholed.
Horizon token (currency hex 486F72697A6F6E…). On-ledger Domain field points to FirstLedger-hosted TOML which lists the issuer back. xrpscan accountName confirms 'Horizon / Issuer / horizonxrpl.com'.

Canonical GateHub USD/EUR issuer. Documented in xrpl.org subscribe examples and used across the XRPL ecosystem as the GateHub fiat-token issuer since 2015. xrpscan attributes to gatehub.net; on-ledger Domain field empty (gatehub.net does not host a public TOML at the standard well-known path).
